title: Download the scoped customer order and receivable packet as PDF
description: User scene: download the already authorized customer report packet as a paginated Chinese PDF with separate sales-order and invoice/receipt evidence sections. Reuse ERP-122's dual menu/salesperson-scope validation and page caps on every download; do not infer invoice-to-order links, balances or mixed-currency totals. Reuse the existing PDFsharp and shared SimHei resolver, fail explicitly if the font is absent, and record the read-only request through existing HTTP audit. Development only: no migration, production SQL, real database execution, arbitrary model SQL, writes, secret/.env change or deployment. Verify PDF and authorization tests plus safe build/test.
acceptance_criteria: PDF endpoint reuses the bounded dual-authorized packet preview, rechecks current user/customer/date/page scope and sends no bytes on either permission failure.
PDFsharp renders separate paginated sales-order and receivable-evidence sections with original currency and explicit known/unknown remaining labels; shared SimHei font absence fails clearly.
Packet page offers PDF download with visible errors; tests inspect PDF signature, Chinese/font failure, separate sections, page cap and dual permission; document export boundary.
